mechanism: Make scale readable immediately by placing a miniature subject beside one ordinary oversized force, then convert pursuit into a route of three materially different terrain actions. Each surface must change the subject's movement verb—run, spring, climb, balance or reach—and the final resource must be earned by the route rather than presented as a decorative giant object.

invariants.rule: Calibrate miniature scale with one ordinary oversized moving force in the opening.
invariants.purpose: Makes size and threat readable without explanation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A tiny subject alone has no reliable scale.

invariants.rule: Change the movement verb at every material handoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous running through new backgrounds becomes a chase montage.

invariants.rule: Use at least three surfaces with visibly different physical responses.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated rigid platforms add no new problem-solving.

invariants.rule: Preserve one travel direction and subject identity across scale changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Discontinuous geography turns actions into unrelated vignettes.

invariants.rule: End with an earned resource that the subject visibly secures or uses.
invariants.purpose: Gives the traversal a purpose beyond survival.
invariants.ablation_failure: A decorative giant object is not a payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source backyard garden route and eating payoff
